results.desc: How each robot ended the round: the turn it died (0 if it survived) and the bullet damage it dealt
results.from: the last turn of the round

outlived.body: other.id != me.id and other.died > 0 and (me.died = 0 or other.died < me.died)

score_of.body: {id: me.id, survival: 50 * count(all[outlived(me, item)]), last_survivor: if me.died = 0 and count(all[item.died = 0]) = 1 then 10 * (count(all) - 1) else 0, bullet_damage: floor(me.damage), total: 50 * count(all[outlived(me, item)]) + (if me.died = 0 and count(all[item.died = 0]) = 1 then 10 * (count(all) - 1) else 0) + floor(me.damage)}

last_survivor_points.desc: Points for the last robot standing, per enemy

scores.desc: Each robot's score for the round, as Robocode counts it: 50 for each robot outlived, 10 per enemy for the last survivor, and 1 per point of bullet damage dealt
scores.expr: for r in results return score_of(r, results)

winner.desc: The robot with the highest total
winner.expr: scores[item.total = max(for s in scores return s.total)][1].id
